verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official Mastercard GitHub repo with an OpenAPI specification. Its test project generates an API client library from that spec "like you would do in a real application", so developers build against self-generated clients rather than prebuilt, maintained SDKs. The agent-toolkit MCP adds AI-generated code examples from the current API specs, which helps but is not an SDK. Missing for 10: published official language SDKs/packages (e.g. npm, PyPI, Maven), SDK documentation and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
